title: moeb-tool-origin failed: ToolSearch and Read used without MissingMoebTool signals
description: Session startup used ToolSearch (external) to load moeb tool schemas and Read (external) to read the oversized start_spec result file. Neither external tool call was accompanied by a buffered MissingMoebTool signal in this run. Rubric moeb-tool-origin marked Fail.
proposed_resolution: Extend moeb tools to load tool schemas natively and read oversized MCP result files via a chunked moeb-native reader. Until then, buffer MissingMoebTool signals immediately after each external call.
